title: BOX OF CRYSTAL, BIRD, CANDLEST...
reason: Unmarked Thai elephant pipe could be silver (weight and metal unverified); rest of the box is unmarked decorative ware.
findings: All 4 photos checked, plus enlarged crops of the pipe bowl, stem and mouthpiece, the crystal dish, the glass bowl and the leaf dish. No maker's marks, hallmarks, labels or stamps are legible on any item (undersides not photographed). Contents: two pale celadon crackle-glaze two-handled vases with ring handles (modern decorator style); a gilt-metal Italian style candle branch with two hand-painted parrots and flowers on a black and gilt base; a pair of glass lovebirds on a crystal base (Murano style or modern, unverified); a large ribbed oval glass bowl with frosted leaf handles holding about a dozen faceted crystal balls; a heavy faceted octagonal clear crystal dish or ashtray (looks like Swarovski or Orrefors style but unmarked, unverified); a small green majolica style leaf dish. The one item that could be worth real money is the Thai-style pipe, about 40 cm long, with an elephant-head bowl, filigree knop, twisted-wire bands, a small hanging bell and a chain-link ear ring, in a yellowish grey tarnished white metal. Enlarged crops show no hallmark, assay mark or maker's stamp, so silver content and weight are NOT supported by the photos (the catalogue says only 'metal pipe').
condition: Pipe is tarnished with surface wear, no obvious breaks or missing pieces in the photos. Vases, glass and dishes show no chips or cracks from the front; bases and undersides not photographed.
rescore_note: Mostly unmarked decorative box (celadon vases, gilt parrot candle branch, glass birds, crystal dish); the Thai elephant pipe is the only upside but has no hallmark, so silver is unproven and discounted. About the $30-80 band, edging towards $80-200 if the pipe is silver. No comps seen.
